integrity: All statements have an explicit elementary proof and reproduced finite diagnostics; no external or independent mathematical verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional regular cross-polytope; fixed Euclidean offset normalized to vertex radius; measure-zero degenerate orientations excluded. Previously published octahedral width/empty-section law and pair-cap formula are acknowledged and not asserted original; equivalent classical stereological results may exist. Exact proof is analytic, with stochastic checks supporting only numerical consistency.
title: Three-phase random noncentral octahedron-section law and its unique quadrilateral optimum
